name: Elon
overview: Elon was a male member of the tribe of Zebulun, known as the son of Zebulun. He is mentioned in the biblical record as part of the descendants of Israel who went to Egypt, specifically listed among the sons of Israel. The descendants of Elon became known as the Elonites, a clan within the tribe of Zebulun.
namesAndTitles: Elon is recorded simply as a proper name without an explicit meaning or divine origin noted in Scripture. His name appears in the genealogical listing in Genesis 46:14.
familyAndRelationships: Elon is explicitly identified as the son of Zebulun. Beyond this, Scripture does not provide additional family relationships for him.
scriptureSignificance: Elon's significance lies in his role as an ancestor within the tribe of Zebulun, contributing to the lineage of Israel that migrated to Egypt. His mention helps establish the genealogical and tribal structure of Israel as recorded in Genesis and later referenced in Numbers. The clan named after him, the Elonites, represents a distinct familial group within Zebulun, underscoring the importance of tribal identity in the biblical narrative.
